WITH patient_avgs AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
), overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
), kept AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, o.avg_hgb AS overall_avg
  FROM patient_avgs p
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
  WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.avg_hgb
), scored AS (
  SELECT ID,
         avg_hgb,
         avg_hgb - overall_avg AS above_overall_avg,
         avg_hgb - AVG(avg_hgb) OVER () AS difference_from_kept_mean
  FROM kept
)
SELECT ID, avg_hgb, above_overall_avg, difference_from_kept_mean
FROM scored
ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
